research_mode: official data.police.uk and Department for Transport primary sources only; anonymisation, provenance, API retrieval, STATS19 coverage, revision, severity and quality gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk outcome join key
verified_claims: uploaded outcomes are joined to original crimes using the offence reference before publication
limitations: the raw offence reference is not published and unmatched outcomes can remain

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk persistent crime identifier
verified_claims: the raw offence reference is replaced by a one-way hash published as persistent_id
limitations: persistent_id is a publication identifier and not a parcel identifier

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk date truncation
verified_claims: crime and outcome dates are truncated to year and month before publication
limitations: day-level incident or outcome timing cannot be inferred

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk offence category mapping
verified_claims: Home Office offence codes are mapped into published crime categories
limitations: the broad category does not preserve every source offence-code distinction

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk approximate location gate
verified_claims: published latitude and longitude represent approximate anonymised locations rather than exact incident coordinates
limitations: coordinates must not be used as exact parcel evidence

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk anonymous map-point privacy rule
verified_claims: anonymous map points are selected to contain at least eight postal addresses or no postal addresses
limitations: a snap point can aggregate multiple possible premises

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk nearest-map-point rule
verified_claims: exact crime coordinates are replaced by the nearest approved map point and are zeroed if that point is more than 20 kilometres away
limitations: distance displacement and zero coordinates require fail-closed spatial handling

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk geocoding accuracy caveat
verified_claims: force geocoding practices are inconsistent and published location accuracy is not fully consistent
limitations: location fields cannot independently support a high-confidence parcel match

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk upload format validation
verified_claims: uploads are rejected when required formatting, valid-date, required-field or geographic checks fail
limitations: passing format validation does not prove semantic correctness

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk force publication approval
verified_claims: forces review upload summaries and approve data as suitable for publication
limitations: provider approval is a quality control rather than independent remeasurement

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk manual anomaly review
verified_claims: manual review checks monthly changes, missing locations, failed anonymisation, boundary anomalies, free text and outcome joins
limitations: manual review can reduce but not eliminate data-quality issues

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk street-crime query geometry
verified_claims: street-level crime can be queried within a one-mile radius or a custom polygon
limitations: query geometry is a retrieval boundary and not proof that an incident occurred at a parcel

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk street-crime result limit
verified_claims: custom areas containing more than 10,000 crimes return an HTTP 503 response
limitations: large-area failures must not be interpreted as zero crime

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk nearest predefined location query
verified_claims: latitude and longitude crime-at-location queries resolve to the nearest predefined location
limitations: the returned location is not an exact coordinate match

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police.uk outcome jurisdiction exclusion
verified_claims: street-level outcomes are not available for the Police Service of Northern Ireland
limitations: absence of outcome rows for Northern Ireland is a coverage limitation rather than a zero outcome count
